title: Stray Kids' Hyun Jin appointed as GUESS's global ambassador, kicking off the brand's global campaign for GUESS JEANS | wowKorea
snippet: GUESS is pleased to announce that Hyun JIN from the world-famous boy band StrayKids has been appointed as the brand's new global ambassador.
extractedText: Home K-wave Stray Kids' Hyun Jin appointed as GUESS's global ambassador, kicking off the brand's global campaign for GUESS JEANS Comment View Gallery (+6) GUESS is pleased to announce that Hyun JIN from the world-famous boy band Stray Kids has been appointed as the brand's new global ambassador. GUESS JEANS unveils its latest global campaign starring Hyun JIN. This partnership marks a significant milestone in the brand's cultural evolution. Known for his overwhelming stage presence and multifaceted artistry, Hyun JIN is a true leader in the GUESS brand with his energy, creativity, and unwavering authenticity. She embodies the brand philosophy of "bold self-expression rooted in culture." This collaboration respects the brand's HYERI heritage while also showcasing a contemporary expression of self. The collaboration reflects the shared vision of both parties to push the boundaries of what is possible. The campaign will feature a theme of "Modern Heritage," proposing a style that combines timeless silhouettes with a contemporary attitude. GUESS is a brand that focuses on classic denim shirts, straight fit jeans, striped tees, and denim cargo pants. GUESS reinterprets the unwavering denim DNA of JEANS with an evolved perspective. Paul Marciano, Co-Founder and Chief Creative Officer "Hyun Jin is a creative talent who transcends the boundaries of performance, spanning music, dance, and visual arts. He has an exceptional sense of style and unwavering confidence. With his unique talent and strong presence on the global stage, he will bring new energy to the GUESS family." Chief New Business Development Officer Nicolai Marciano "I am very pleased to welcome Hyun JIN to the GUESS family. Music and culture have always had a big influence on my fashion sense. Hyun Jin demonstrates exceptional artistry in everything he does. We believe he represents a new era of expression for the brand.” As a global ambassador for GUESS and GUESS JEANS, Hyun JIN will lead worldwide campaigns and major brand projects, and will also be involved in the HYERI stage. Inspired by the past, but with a future-oriented perspective, GUESS will open up a new chapter. The collection worn by Hyun JIN will be available at GUESS from Friday, March 6th. The items will be released sequentially at JEANS Tokyo, GUESS Shibuya, and the official online store. In addition, customers who purchase the target products will receive a limited edition design for this campaign. GUESS JEANS Tokyo offers a laser printing customization service for the "Hyunjin logo." For details of the service, please see the store website. Please contact our staff.
